operator: hostapd 2.11 and a local Scapy/AF_PACKET DHCP-DNS responder in an OrbStack Ubuntu 26.04.1 arm64 VM; console owner reconnected the console for the control and D-01

console.model_source: owner manual confirmation; PTP DeviceInfo reports the generic model 'Nintendo Switch'
console.firmware_observation_note: The console was not enumerated during this test; the firmware value is the owner's report.
console.modification_source: owner report; this test does not detect modifications

connection.virtualization: OrbStack 2.2.5 (fresh ldn2 VM after a USB-controller failure)

control.dhcp: valid offer and ACK delivered by the local responder
control.transport_attempt: TCP SYN from 192.168.77.94 to 2.19.126.212:80; no responder/NAT

case.console_requests: the console sent repeated DHCPREQUEST frames after the malformed OFFER; the responder intentionally did not send a valid ACK
case.note: A first D-01 attempt was inconclusive: no DHCP frame reached the responder or pcap, the console showed 2110-1100, and the AP data path had wedged. After a driver reload, the retry produced the valid exchange above.

blocker.summary: The rtw88_8822bu AP data path becomes unreliable after a test cycle; the first D-01 attempt and the D-02 attempt produced no DHCP frames/hostapd AP-ENABLED state until the driver was reloaded. The ldn2 interface/hostapd path later hung during iw/hostapd cleanup.
blocker.remaining_cases: D-02-D-08 and N-01-N-10 were not completed.
blocker.console_state: The two test networks remain saved; no other console setting was changed.

interpretation: The control passed the DHCP and DNS stages: the console obtained a valid lease, resolved ctest.cdn.nintendo.net, and attempted TCP to the resolved Akamai address, failing only at the internet step with 2110-3129 because there was no NAT. D-01 then sent a single DHCPOFFER with the subnet-mask option length 0; the console rejected the offer, sent repeated DHCPREQUESTs, and reported 2110-2963. It stayed responsive and disconnected normally after about 30 seconds. No crash, reboot, hang, or new error code occurred. This is a clean negative for D-01. The remaining DHCP/DNS cases are blocked by the adapter's intermittent AP data path, not by a console result; no malformed DNS was sent. H-012 remains UNVERIFIED.
authorization: The owner approved the Phase 4 control C, then D-01 only. The full D-02-D-08 sequence was approved later, but the adapter data path failed before D-02 could be tested; no D-02-D-08 frames were sent.
limitations: One console, one adapter, one driver, and channel 1 only.
The rtw88_8822bu AP data path is intermittent and required a driver reload between the control and D-01; D-02 could not be started reliably.
The local DHCP/DNS responder uses raw AF_PACKET and Scapy send; it is not a production DHCP server.
D-01 was observed once after a reload; the first attempt was inconclusive because no DHCP frame reached the host.
No malformed DNS case was sent; the DNS surface is untested beyond the valid control.
The two test networks remain saved on the console until the owner removes them.
No crash, hang, or reboot occurred; this is not an exploit or a memory-safety proof.
redactions: Console and adapter MAC addresses redacted.
Interface name redacted because it is derived from the adapter MAC.
